audit_response.rive: Custom 2D cutout skeletal rig, explicitly NOT Rive (no artboard/mesh/state-machine/.riv). Real-Rive path via a pre-made human_template.riv on the Rive Web Runtime remains optional/pending.
audit_response.figure_detection: Keyword figure-gate replaced by an explicit CharacterManifest (vision in production, structured figure_construction offline) + _ensure_articulation guaranteeing a skeletal_pose post-plan.
audit_response.anatomical_separation: Capsule carving removed as accepted output. AnatomicalPartSegmenter: whole-char mask + pose keypoints + per-limb SAM2 refinement (negative points exclude torso/far-limb) + joint overlap + occlusion z-order + per-part QC/retry + confidence; part_qc renders a contact sheet + structural + optional Qwen vision gate. Production refuses geometric/QC-flagged parts. SAM2 per-limb refinement is GPU-gated (unverified offline); the offline geometric preview is QC-flagged, not accepted.
audit_response.remotion_articulation: DONE. Nested-FK SkeletalLayer renders object-level articulation; proven by an actual Remotion render and a full pipeline->Remotion run (both show limb articulation on the MP4).
audit_response.perceptual_qc: DONE. part_qc checks joint gaps, background leakage, occlusion order, torso-drag, limb-length/tearing (area-spread) + optional Qwen vision gate incl. pose-fits-narration.
audit_response.still_open: FLUX isolated hero assets (F7) are now built as an opt-in path (gated on a real image generator); Remotion is now the auto-default (F5); the optional Rive .riv template integration is provided as opt-in/last-resort (a binary .riv must still be authored in the Rive Editor). WAN/SkyReels are wired but GPU-gated (video generation unverified offline). No gap/torso-drag cleanliness needs the SAM2 production path (GPU).
audit_response.production_reliability_P1: Artifact DAG built on top of job_runtime stage-resume: per-node artifact_key + dependency-aware invalidation + failure classification (TRANSIENT/MODERATION/QUALITY_FAILURE/INVALID_INPUT/PROVIDER_FAILURE/FATAL) -> repair strategy + node state machine + lineage (graph/, attempts/). Emitted on every run. Deep DAG-driven execution (replacing linear job_runtime.execute per node) is the next increment; the engine + all 5 acceptance criteria are met and tested.
audit_response.provider_router_P2: VisualProviderRouter centralizes image recovery (moderation recovery is now its sub-component). BFL primary; Gemini/local HF are opt-in fallbacks injected via studio.extra_visual_providers, tried only after BFL recovery is exhausted, per-asset. Production image lock unchanged by default.
audit_response.scientific_truth_P3: Claim graph traces every scene claim to evidence with confidence + source type (peer_reviewed/preprint/web from provider+authority) and flags scientific-looking visuals with no supporting claim. Production research produces real lineage; the offline demo has weak stub-evidence which the graph honestly flags.

providers.reasoning: OpenAI GPT via OPENAI_API_KEY (exclusive in production)
providers.vision_review: Two-tier via ONE OpenRouter key: Qwen VL (qwen/qwen-2.5-vl-72b-instruct) primary ~80%, escalate difficult/low-confidence cases to Gemini 2.5 Flash (google/gemini-2.5-flash) ~20% — both through OPENROUTER_API_KEY. OpenAI permitted as vision fallback. Imperfect critiques are salvaged into valid change orders instead of hard-failing.
providers.image_generation: BFL FLUX Kontext via BFL_API_KEY (exclusive in production)
providers.reference_motion: Reference video motion dynamics (energy/tempo/cut-rate) measured via frame differencing and fed to the animation director so motion matches the reference's rhythm; guarded (no-op if measurement fails).
providers.animation: Authored animation DSL per shot (Director-authored: object state change is primary; camera/particles/captions are opt-in supporting elements, off by default). Renderer is a pure executor. Primary quality gate is causal clarity, not motion energy.
providers.object_separation: Grounded: ObjectGrounder (Qwen VL authors bbox/points/pivot/depth/states; deterministic fallback) -> SAM2 prompted by that grounding (not image centre), heuristic fallback -> mask QC gate (empty/near-full/bbox-overlap/duplicate) with retry. Per-object alpha masks; visible pixels always from the beauty frame.
providers.art_direction: Flat vector science-explainer (Kurzgesagt-style): bold separable shapes, clean outlines, flat fills, negative space for labels. Replaces the painterly editorial-ink canon.
providers.compositing: Per-object clean-plate compositing: moving objects removed from an inpainted background plate (OpenCV Telea or PIL bleed fallback); depth z-index preserved from grounded depth (not flattened); object-local rotate/scale about the object pivot.
providers.renderers: PIL (deterministic/offline) and Remotion (production) consume the SAME authored DSL (events/camera/effects/captions + per-layer pivot/bbox/z). The Remotion template iterates all events per layer (not one), applies easing, transforms about the object pivot, and executes camera/effect/caption directives.
providers.post_render_qc: Rendered causal clarity is verified from real first/last frames + the object mask: an action shot must show the object region actually change; a declared hold must not. render_verified is set from frame evidence (not JSON). Optional Qwen VL before/after gate is GPU/API-gated. Wired as a guarded pipeline pass writing 20_render_qc/*.json.
